headline: Conservation-informed deep learning predicts cross-species RBP-RNA binding peaks
label: Deep Learning Functional Unit Prioritization
summary: Deep learning models now prioritize functional RNA-binding, regulatory, and non-coding elements directly from sequence, conservation, and multi-omics inputs.
synthesis: The dominant thread is representation-driven prioritization of functional units from sequence, conservation, or multi-omics inputs, although the items differ in scope. MuSIC, a deep learning framework, predicts cross-species RBP-RNA binding peaks using RBP evolutionary conservation across 11 species, which distinguishes it from sequence-only approaches. ProteoCast applies a related conservation logic to predict missense variant impact proteome-wide in Drosophila, validated against lethal and population data. The functional non-coding variation item integrates personal haplotypes, allele-specific regulation, and deep learning to map variant effects on TF binding and chromatin accessibility. FASTER extends evolutionary analysis to predicted molecular function rather than sequence alone. Other items, including the HAP1 genetic interaction map and RNAStructuromeDB, address adjacent questions and share the thread only loosely.
